readLogFile_parse_binary_log: read a binary log file with struct format strings and alignment byte delimiters into a list of records
run_kuka_playback_simulation: run a PyBullet GUI simulation that loads a Kuka IIWA robot arm and replays recorded joint states from a log file
resetBasePositionAndOrientation_set_robo: reset the base position and orientation of a PyBullet body using position and quaternion values from a log record
resetJointState_set_joint_values: reset individual joint states of a PyBullet robot body using recorded joint index values from a log file
getJointInfo_query_joint_data: query joint information for a PyBullet body to retrieve the joint index for setting joint states during playback
